commits.summary: Freeze byte-bound Java kernel requests (verification pending)
commits.body:
Freeze the external theorems, assumptions, controls and cost measures before implementing a consumer. Extract the Guava 33.4.8 release entries, match their complete digests against the archived obligations, and compile a named multiply/add scalar pair and its shifted negative on Temurin 21. The setup note abbreviated Ints with a suffix belonging to an inner class. The release and both historical bindings agree on the full hash used here.

Jobs 20261123-191504-reproduce-both-guava-any-length-producer and 20261123-191505-capture-real-bounded-solver-queries-for regenerate both producer baselines and capture the bounded native query stream. The four request bindings, existing receipt reader, job validation and all eight changed-test groups passed, including 59 Rust binaries.

commits.summary: Compare independent scalar proof consumers (verification pending)
commits.body:
Both routes start with the same compiled public multiply and add methods. Rust decodes the class and reduces JVM stack expressions modulo 2^32. Lean reads the complete file as a literal term, finds Code through the constant pool and proves a normal return with unchanged heap for every 32-bit input. Its shifted peer differs at zero. The Lean proof uses the standard propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound axioms. The Linux read-only consumer sandbox excludes the original producer, verdicts and proof caches.

The separate Rust and Lean probes accepted the original class, the named Lean negative theorem checked, and all 59 selected Rust test binaries passed. Job 20261123-192639-compare-isolated-rust-and-lean-on-compil repeats each check three times under isolation. Merge the two original producer baselines: both matched the archived status and every obligation, 10 answers for Ints and 11 for Longs. An incremental-formula fixture confirmed clause and per-call assumption selection for the parallel LRAT comparator.

commits.summary: Freeze the public int-array induction checker (verification pending)
commits.body:
Check Guava's public invokestatic target, the unchanged whole-array arguments, and both helper exits from original class bytes. The nonmatching prefix, unchanged heap and strictly decreasing Java-int remaining length discharge 34 keyed edge obligations. Frozen checker 8732c7a527559fa4 accepted Ints then refused the first 346 request at its element descriptor before any width change. Both first results, requests, certificates and source digests are retained.

The original JVM confirmed the five int mutants. On the heap-writing variant, the honest producer reported SAT only on the failing frame. The independent checker replayed [7] with target 7, correct result zero and changed heap [0]. All 59 selected Rust binaries passed. Job 20261123-194123-freeze-the-public-ints-proof-and-try-lon repeats the controls and pre-edit Longs attempt. Merge both measured scalar routes and the bounded capture. Job 20261123-194123-certify-all-observed-bounded-guava-and-p checks every recorded UNSAT for Guava and the fallback prefix-sums workload.

commits.summary: Transfer the frozen index proof to long cells (verification pending)
commits.body:
Bind the category-2 target and int index locals for Longs, read 64-bit cells and derive equality through the real lcmp branch. The existing entry, prefix, frame, exit and termination rules and certificate format carry over. The first transfer probe proved the release on 35 keyed obligations and replayed [0,4294967296] against a truncating comparison. The original JVM agreed. The unchanged 336 source bundle rebuilds its recorded binary byte for byte.

Preserve the passed frozen qualification and its eight substitution controls. Job 20261123-195310-qualify-the-64-bit-transfer-and-held-bac repeats the int and long controls, compares a held-back wrapper layout and a real same-value write, and injects an erroneous frame premise at the experimental issuer. Its consumer has demonstrably denied access to the original producer, prior verdict and cache. The three held-back JVM observations, pipeline validation and 59 selected Rust test binaries passed. A native timing parent and clean bundle replay support the final cost comparison.

commits.summary: Qualify clean proof replay and range fill (verification pending)
commits.body:
Merge all passing long-transfer and LRAT receipts. Both Guava requests are checked from their original bytes. All six behavioral mutants have checked witnesses, and the held-back wrapper layout and equal-value store both pass. CaDiCaL and cake_lpr verified all eight bounded Guava UNSAT calls and ten prefix-sums UNSAT calls, with rejected damaged and known-SAT controls.

The first SAT summary mixed the proof-only counter with two separate reachability calls. A fresh capped probe got 24 of 24 solver calls in the proof and 2 of 2 in the probe. Job 20261123-200519-reconcile-both-guava-solver-passes-with binds both raw native logs to the previously certified streams and checks the corrected counts. Job 20261123-200519-replay-clean-java-proof-bundles-and-meas rebuilds the sealed consumer and measures generation and checking on one host.

With both required cases and controls collected, job 20261123-200520-measure-the-range-fill-and-aliased-calle measures the three 337 contracts in order. The JVM driver checked 50 direct fills and 75 inputs per caller. On a shared singleton and empty range the extra-write caller returned 7 where the observation requires 11. All selected 59 Rust binaries, pipeline validation, strict-scope transcript comparison and separate-counter regressions passed.

commits.summary: Record the independent Guava proof and investment decision
commits.body:
Recommend one further semantic family, the write frame of JDK range fill. Isolated Rust checks establish the complete public Ints and Longs first-match theorems and catch all six rebound behavioral mutants. Two unfamiliar positive controls passed. The known 64-bit transfer cost 49 net acceptance lines and 44 net concrete-witness lines, with the original certificate format, invariant, frame and decrease rules retained.

Publish the 88-case table, 113 pinned evidence and implementation files, measured costs and replay commands. Three fresh Rust checks had median times of 1.35 ms and 1.11 ms at 1.8 MiB peak, compared with 1.19 seconds for either historical replay. The scalar Lean proof checks the compiled bytes. Independent LRAT checking covers all eight Guava and ten prefix-sums UNSAT calls. The proof and reachability counters were independently reconciled against their recorded native logs.

Nine pipeline jobs passed, including byte-identical frozen consumer rebuilding, both engines' scalar controls, fresh checking without producer access, and the optional 337 measurements. Its historical extra caller remains unresolved, while a separate JVM witness on an aliased singleton returned 7 where the contract requires 11. The audit passed with two hash seeds, all 18 local documentation links resolved, the pipeline validated, and all five changed-test groups passed, including 59 Rust binaries and four Python suites.
